title: Langfuse Secret API key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: The four UUID hyphens are removed, so the body is 32 bare hex characters instead of the 8-4-4-4-12 grouping; the hex characters are unchanged. Twin of "Langfuse Secret API key: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
